subject: Seat allocation & coverage alignment for Outreach renewal
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@outreach.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Seat allocation & coverage alignment for Outreach renewal

Tom —

Thanks again for the quick renewal timeline earlier. We dug into seat usage for Q2 and there are a few housekeeping items we want to resolve before signing the upcoming renewal:

- Several seats are assigned to inactive sequences (SDR pilot teams) and usage shows ~40% idle.
- Our AE org expects a small headcount shift from EMEA -> US which should reduce total Outreach seats needed by ~15-20% for the next 12 months.
- We want to avoid a full seat true-up at renewal if we can reallocate or convert to shared/seat-pools.

Can you share a proposal for:
1) A seat reallocation plan that lets us move unused seats between teams mid-term.
2) Pricing/credit options if we reduce active seats prior to contract renewal (what credits are available and how are they applied).
3) Any administrative overhead or lead times (Procurement/PO/DocuSign timeline) you expect.

Attached is our Q2 usage export for reference. If it helps, we can schedule 30 minutes this week to walk through buckets.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: outreach_seat_usage_Q2_2026.csv (csv)

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@outreach.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: renewals@outreach.io
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Seat allocation & coverage alignment for Outreach renewal

Karthik —

Appreciate the context and the data dump. Quick note before we do a deeper model: Outreach can support seat pooling and reassignments, but the economics differ by contract term and commitment level.

I ran a preliminary pass and attached a short adjustment proposal: it outlines three paths — (A) reallocate inactive seats internally and keep committed seats the same (minimal fee, admin-only), (B) reduce committed seat count now and take a pro-rated credit (requires PO amendment), or (C) move to an org-level pool with flexible seat assignment for an incremental fee but simpler ops.

High level: option B looks like what you're after; with your current term we can provide a pro-rated credit for unused committed seats provided we amend the SOW and sign within 14 days. Option C adds a $X/month seat-pool admin fee but avoids future true-ups.

I attached the proposal and a redline-friendly PDF for your legal team. If you want, I can open a DocuSign envelope for the PO amendment once you confirm path.

Cheers,
Tom
Account Exec — Renewals (West)
Outreach

Attachments: outreach_proposed_adjustment_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: procurement path for mid-contract seat reductions

Lauren —

Quick question for procurement/process: Outreach is offering a pro-rated credit if we reduce committed seats now and sign an amendment within 14 days (Tom attached proposal). What's our standard approach for:

- Mid-term seat reductions that generate a credit (do we require a counter-signed amendment + PO change first, or can we accept a credit to next invoice?)
- Does Finance need a revised contract version before we approve the credit?
- Any internal approval thresholds I should be aware of (e.g., >$50k requires VP sign-off)?

Marissa/Ben — tagging you for headcount confirmation on which teams (SDR pilot, AE US) we can remove seats from.

If we go the amendment route I'd like to move fast — can you confirm seats by EOD?

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: procurement path for mid-contract seat reductions

Karthik / Marissa —

We can free up 28 seats from the SDR pilot (inactive sequences), and the AE redistribution should reduce need by ~12 seats. Combined that gives ~40 seats of headroom.

Action for me: I'll prepare a short mapping (team -> seat ids) and share before EOD Monday so you have an auditable list for Outreach.

—Ben

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@outreach.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, renewals@outreach.io
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Seat allocation & coverage alignment for Outreach renewal

Tom / Renewals team —

Thanks for the proposal — option B (pro-rated credit + PO amendment) works for us. Internal confirmation: 40 seats can be released per Ben's mapping (attached shortly).

Proposed mutual action plan:
1) Outreach prepares PO amendment and DocuSign envelope reflecting -40 seats and pro-rated credit. (Target: sign by 2026-08-05)
2) Redwood provides the seat mapping CSV and a one-page approver note for Finance. (Target: 2026-07-30)
3) Outreach returns the redlined SOW if legal needs edits (we'll loop legal only if >standard language). (Target: 2026-08-03)
4) Apply credit to next invoice following DocuSign completion.

Please open the DocuSign when you have the PO amendment ready and cc renewals@outreach.io. I am attaching a short license notes file for your SAs.

Karthik
Director, GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: license_breakdown_notes.txt (txt)
